steps.title: Charge
steps.imageAlt: G Pen Elite II charging port

bullets.text: Plug **any USB-C cable** into the charging port on the bottom.
Give it a full charge before first use.
The LED blinks **8 times** when the battery is low.

steps.title: Load
steps.imageAlt: Loading the G Pen Elite II herb chamber

bullets.text: Remove the **mouthpiece** by pulling it straight up.
Fill the **ceramic oven** with finely ground dry herb — don't pack tight.
Replace the mouthpiece before powering on.

note.text: **Tip:** Use the built-in pick tool stored at the base of the device to pack and stir the chamber.

steps.title: Set & Heat
steps.imageAlt: Setting temperature on the G Pen Elite II

bullets.text: **Hold the power button for 3 seconds** to power on. The display lights up.
Press **+ / −** to dial in your temperature.
**Double-click** to start a session. The device vibrates when it's at temp.

press.sub: Hold the power button for 3 seconds

steps.title: Draw
steps.imageAlt: Drawing from the G Pen Elite II

bullets.text: Once the device vibrates, **draw slowly and steadily** through the mouthpiece.
The session auto-ends when the countdown hits 0:00.
Device powers off automatically after **1 minute** of inactivity.

note.text: **After your session:** Let cool, then use the pick tool to stir the chamber and brush out residue. Regular cleaning keeps flavor at its best.

faq.question: Device won't turn on
faq.answer: Hold the power button for a full 3 seconds. If nothing happens, charge the device — the battery may be depleted.

faq.question: How do I know it's ready?
faq.answer: After double-clicking to start a session, the device vibrates once when it reaches your set temperature. The session countdown begins on the display.

faq.question: Vapor is thin or tastes off
faq.answer: Try a finer grind and check that the chamber isn't overpacked. Use the built-in pick tool to stir the load mid-session. Clean the mouthpiece and chamber regularly.

faq.question: What does the warranty cover?
faq.answer: The Elite II includes a 2-year limited warranty covering electronics and manufacturing defects. Register at gpen.com to extend it to 3 years.
